arxiv-2105-08151.title: On Using P2P Technology for Decentralized Detection of Service Level Agreement Violations
arxiv-2105-08151.creator: Jéferson C. Nobre, Lisandro Z. Granville, Alberto G. Prieto, Alexander Clemm
arxiv-2105-08151.description: Abstract Critical networked services enable significant revenue for network operators and, in turn, are regulated by Service Level Agreements (SLAs). In order to ensure SLAs are being met, service levels need to be monitored. One technique for this involves active measurement mechanisms which employ measurement probes along the network to inject synthetic traffic and compute the network performance.

arxiv-2108-09401.title: Confined and eruptive catastrophes of solar magnetic flux ropes caused by mass loading and unloading
arxiv-2108-09401.creator: Quanhao Zhang, Rui Liu, Yuming Wang, Xiaolei Li, Shaoyu Lyu
arxiv-2108-09401.description: Abstract It is widely accepted that coronal magnetic flux ropes are the core structures of large-scale solar eruptive activities, which inflict dramatic impacts on the solar-terrestrial system. Previous studies have demonstrated that varying magnetic properties of a coronal flux rope system could result in a catastrophe of the rope, which may trigger solar eruptive activities.

arxiv-2209-08736.title: A new canonical affine BRACKET formulation of Hamiltonian Classical Field theories of first order Thanks: J.C.M. thanks H. Bursztyn, A. Cabrera, S. Capriotti and D. Iglesias for stimulating discussions on the topics of this paper. J.C.M. has been partially supported by Ministerio de Economía y Compe
arxiv-2209-08736.creator: François Gay-Balmaz, Juan C. Marrero, Nicolás Martínez
arxiv-2209-08736.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by François Gay-Balmaz, Juan C. Marrero, Nicolás Martínez. It has been a long standing question how to extend, in the finite-dimensional setting, the canonical Poisson bracket formulation from classical mechanics to classical field theories, in a completely general, intrinsic, and canonical way. In this paper, we provide an answer to this question by presenting a new completely canonical bracket formulation of Hamiltonian Classical Field Theories of first order on an arbitrary configuration bundle.

arxiv-2311-18793.title: Finite-volume scattering on the left-hand cut
arxiv-2311-18793.creator: A. Baião Raposo, and M. T. Hansen
arxiv-2311-18793.description: Abstract The two-particle finite-volume scattering formalism derived by Lüscher and generalized in many subsequent works does not hold for energies far enough below the two-particle threshold to reach the nearest left-hand cut. The breakdown of the formalism is signaled by the fact that a real scattering amplitude is predicted in a regime where it should be complex.

arxiv-2502-15622.title: MemoryPods: Enhancing Asynchronous Communication in Extended Reality
arxiv-2502-15622.description: Abstract Asynchronous communication has become increasingly essential in the context of extended reality (XR), enabling users to interact and share information immersively without the constraints of simultaneous engagement. However, current XR systems often struggle to support effective asynchronous interactions, mainly due to limitations in contextual replay and navigation.

arxiv-2508-08749.title: Approximate DBSCAN under Differential Privacy
arxiv-2508-08749.creator: Yuan Qiu, Ke Yi
arxiv-2508-08749.description: Abstract This paper revisits the DBSCAN problem under differential privacy (DP). Existing DP-DBSCAN algorithms aim at publishing the cluster labels of the input points. However, we show that both empirically and theoretically, this approach cannot offer any utility in the published results. We therefore propose an alternative definition of DP-DBSCAN based on the notion of spans.

arxiv-2511-12762.title: Observations of Five Southern-Hemisphere Cataclysmic Binary Stars
arxiv-2511-12762.creator: John R. Thorstensen, Annabelle E. Niblett, Shreya Gandhi, Lauren P. Zanarini, Gavin D. Goss, Arnav Singh, Divik Verma, Ryan C. Hickox, Emmanuel A. Durodola, Jiaqi Martin Ying
arxiv-2511-12762.description: Abstract We present observations and analyses of five little-studied cataclysmic binary stars in the southern celestial hemisphere. Our new observations are from the South African Astronomical Observatory. The objects and salient results are as follows: (i) 6dF0752-54 is a dwarf nova with an orbital period P orb P_{\rm orb} = 5.

pmc-10672413.title: Four New Endophytic Apiospora Species Isolated from Three Dicranopteris Species in Guizhou, China
pmc-10672413.creator: Jing-Yi Zhang, Meng-Lan Chen, Saranyaphat Boonmee, Yu-Xuan Wang, Yong-Zhong Lu, Gary A Strobel
pmc-10672413.description: Endophytic fungi isolated from medicinal ferns serve as significant natural resources for drug precursors or bioactive metabolites. During our survey on the diversity of endophytic fungi from Dicranopteris species (a genus of medicinal ferns) in Guizhou, Apoiospora was observed as a dominant fungal group.

pmc-11541042.title: Effects of organic and inorganic selenium mixes in pregnant sows on piglet growth, selenium levels in serum and milk, and selenium deposition in newborn piglet tissues
pmc-11541042.creator: Xing Hao Jin, Min Soo Park, Min Hyuk Jang, Cheon Soo Kim, Yoo Yong Kim
pmc-11541042.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ObjectiveThis study was conducted to evaluate the effects of organic and inorganic selenium mixes in pregnant sows on piglet growth, selenium levels in serum and milk, and selenium deposition in newborn piglet tissues.MethodsA total of 44 multiparous sows (Yorkshire×Landrace) with average body weight (BW), backfat thickness, and parity were assigned to one of the three treatments with 14 or 15 sows per treatment in a completely randomized design.

pmc-12440517.title: Efficacy of ultrasound-guided lateral quadratus lumborum block on postoperative pain and quality of recovery in patients undergoing open nephrectomy: A randomized controlled study
pmc-12440517.creator: Büşra Yağbasan, Levent Özdemir
pmc-12440517.description: Background:In our study, we aimed to evaluate the effects of lateral quadratus lumborum block (QLB) on postoperative pain and quality of recovery (QoR) in patients undergoing open nephrectomy.Methods:This study was designed as a randomized, prospective study. Patients were divided into 2 groups as lateral QLB group (group QLB) and Morphine group (group M).

pmc-12788013.title: Engineering Polyampholytes for Energy Storage Devices: Conductivity, Selectivity, and Durability
pmc-12788013.creator: Madina Mussalimova, Nargiz Gizatullina, Gaukhargul Yelemessova, Anel Taubatyrova, Zhanserik Shynykul, Gaukhar Toleutay
pmc-12788013.description: Polyampholytes combine cationic and anionic groups in one macromolecular platform and are emerging as versatile components for energy storage and conversion. This review synthesizes how their charge balance, hydration, and architecture can be engineered to address ionic transport, interfacial stability, and safety across batteries, supercapacitors, solar cells, and fuel cells.

pmc-13251202.title: A practical workflow for applying validation strategies in tree height–diameter modelling☆
pmc-13251202.creator: Santosh Ayer, Kishor Prasad Bhatta
pmc-13251202.description: Accurate validation of height–diameter (H–D) models is important for forest modelling applications, yet validation approaches are often applied inconsistently across forestry studies. This may produce different estimates of model performance depending on data structure and validation conditions. Therefore, the objective of this study was to present a practical workflow for applying internal, grouped, and external validation approaches in H–D modelling.

pmc-13372826.title: Clinical factors associated with retreatment and early coronary outcomes in Kawasaki disease in children aged < 6 months: a single-center cohort study
pmc-13372826.creator: Kensuke Horinouchi, Kentaro Ueno, Hiroki Iwaizako, Tsubasa Shimozono, Junpei Kawamura, Daisuke Hazeki, Toshirou Fukushige, Yuichi Nomura
pmc-13372826.description: To evaluate whether pre-treatment coronary artery aneurysm (CAA) Z-score, inflammatory markers, and incomplete Kawasaki disease (KD) status are associated with intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG) retreatment and early coronary outcomes in infants aged < 6 months. We retrospectively reviewed infants aged < 6 months who were treated with IVIG for KD between 2011 and 2024.

pmc-13494306.title: Modeling multistage transition probability in blood pressure progression stages among hypertensive patients, southern Ethiopia: A retrospective cohort study
pmc-13494306.creator: Dereje Danbe Debeko, Tayesew Shegaw
pmc-13494306.description: IntroductionHypertension is the primary cause of cardiovascular death and a major contributor to heart attack, stroke, chronic heart disease, and kidney failure. The aim of this study was to estimate multistage transition probability and identify associated risk factors among hypertensive patients.

pmc-13526858.title: Ribo-ITP enables identification of translons from limited input samples
pmc-13526858.creator: Vighnesh Ghatpande, Uma Paul, Logan Persyn, Yifan Tian, MacKenzie A. Howard, Can Cenik

pmc-13660062.title: Evaluating mental health integration in PrEP programs to reduce HIV incidence among US gay and bisexual men: a network modeling study
pmc-13660062.creator: Udodirim N Onwubiko, Adrien Le Guillou, Allison T Chamberlain, David Benkeser, David P Holland, Stefan D Baral, Samuel M Jenness
pmc-13660062.description: BackgroundDespite advances in HIV prevention, achieving elimination in the United States (US) remains challenging, particularly among gay, bisexual, and other men who have sex with men (GBMSM). Psychosocial barriers, including stigma and mental health challenges, influence sexual behaviors and hinder engagement in HIV prevention and care, suggesting that integrated interventions may improve HIV-related service uptake and reduce HIV incidence.
